verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers wallets, payments, webhooks, onramp/offramp, MCP/CLI tooling, and x402 monetization, but nowhere describes a scheduler, cron-style job runner, or recurring/subscription billing mechanism for automating repeated workflows. Webhooks (docs-15/16/24) are event-driven, not schedule-based, and no doc mentions recurring transfers, subscriptions, or timed automation.
